runtimeStatus.description: Current runtime availability reported by the gateway.

uptimeMs.description: Time since server startup in milliseconds.

webhook.description: Read-only namespace webhook status when configured. No recipient, credential or conversation identifiers are disclosed.

HealthResult.description: Gateway health response from client.server.health(). On product connections, access is authorized by the server.

lastRefusal.description: Most recent non-attempt refusal in this process; it can remain after progress and is not current authority or a delivery outcome.

WebhookPendingOutcome.description: Retained local settlement work; response does not itself confirm durable publication.

WebhookNativeMutations.description: Native webhook mutation admission. A retained attempt excludes native mutations through consumed settlement acknowledgement; canonical revoke and unshare are independent.

WebhookRefusal.description: A refusal before a transport attempt; it neither consumes an attempt nor means revocation.
